name: Tam Coc food guide
summary: After the boat, lunch in Tam Coc is crisp rice, mountain goat, and nem Yên Mạc. Mountain snail comes in the rains, Hang Bụt is a meal you cook, and midday can be cá rô Tổng Trường.
body: After the boat, eat cơm cháy at a Tam Coc restaurant. The crisp rice there is nếp hương with ruốc, with mountain goat or with heart and kidney stir-fried with carrot, tomato, mushroom, and onion. The Ninh Bình plate is beef tenderloin and pork heart and kidney, with tomato, carrot, onion, and shiitake, poured on so the rice crackles. That beef plate is also served in the city or the old capital.

Lunch in the tourist area, or at a restaurant nearby, is that rice, mountain goat, and nem Yên Mạc. A Tam Coc day sets dê tái chanh, cơm cháy, and grilled goat at 11:45. Nem Yên Mạc is a Yên Mạc plate and a Yên Mô plate as well as this lunch.

From April to August, mountain snail comes out of the rock caves. Have it grilled, stir-fried with tamarind, steamed with ginger, boiled, or in an onion salad. At Hang Bụt you grill the perch you catch and cook crab soup and salted eggplant. The cave is 1 km from chùa Bích Động, and the visit is also in Sơn Hà.

At midday, cá rô Tổng Trường comes with mountain goat and crisp rice, and it is called a Ninh Bình specialty. Tổng Trường is the old name of xã Trường Yên in Hoa Lư, where the fish is cooked rang, rán, kho, or as canh chua with fried perch, pickled mustard greens, diluted nước dưa, tomato, and fried tofu. The same fish is served in the city or the old capital, and a Tet table has it kho tộ or rán giòn with hot rice.
specialtiesLead: Crisp rice, hill goat, nem Yên Mạc, mountain snail, the Hang Bụt meal, and cá rô Tổng Trường.

sections.heading: Tam Coc specialties
paragraphs: Cơm cháy is the crisp rice you break into the bowl. Thịt dê núi, dê nướng, and dê tái chanh are the goat, with the hill herbs. Nem Yên Mạc is the fermented pork at lunch. The snail plates run from April to August. At Hang Bụt you cook cá rô nướng, canh cua, and cà muối yourself. Cá rô Tổng Trường is the midday perch.
